content.help: Master toggle. Applies instantly.
Seconds between position samples per NPC. Lower = faster reaction, slightly more CPU.
Consecutive stuck samples before acting. Interval x Threshold = reaction time (default ~1s). Followers react twice as fast.
An NPC trying to move but covering less than this many units per sample counts as stuck.
Seconds before the same NPC can be unstuck again. Followers use half of this.
Round-robin slice size. 10 covers a busy city within a few frames.

Soft cap on this mod's work per frame. Detection is always cheap; the expensive part (ledge sweeps, leap planning) is queued and runs a couple per frame while under this budget, so a crowd of stuck NPCs can never cause a frame spike. Lower = smoother but slower to react. 0 = no cap.
Log every parkour/teleport event to NPCPathingNG.log.
Stuck NPCs vault/climb via SkyParkour animations. Needs SkyParkour V3 + Nemesis/Pandora patch.
What NPCs may do inside interior cells. Default: nothing (teleport fallback still works).

Tallest ledge NPCs will climb (game units). 130 (default) = steps, vaults and low/chest ledges — NPCs won't scale walls, houses or mountains. Raise toward 250 (SkyParkour's own player max) for full cliff climbing. Note: 130 is intentionally lower than the player's range so NPCs stay grounded.

NPCs farther than this (game units) will not play SkyParkour animations. SkyParkour climb sounds are 2D — they play at your ears with no fade — so a distant or off-screen NPC otherwise sounds like someone climbing next to you. 1600 is the default. 0 = no limit (old behaviour).

Stuck NPCs near an EVG marker use it as a route: a SkyParkour move along the marker's heading when the geometry matches, otherwise a collision-validated hop across the marker. Only fires for NPCs that are actually stuck, approaching the marker from its entry side. Needs EVG Animated Traversal installed; harmless without it, and your own EVG use is unaffected.
When SkyParkour and EVG cannot help, sidestep-teleport the NPC around the obstacle as a collision-validated last resort.
How far sideways the bypass teleport goes.

How many times an NPC must fail to escape via parkour/EVG before a teleport is allowed. Higher = teleport is rarer and animated traversal is preferred. Combined with a genuine wall-block check, this stops NPCs teleporting when they could path or climb instead.

Auto (recommended): the mod detects Fluid Motion and NpcTraversalNG (Enemies Can Jump and Vault) at game start. If either handles NPC jumps/vaults/climbs, they act first and this mod only steps in as a fallback for NPCs they left stuck, and never moves an NPC they are flying. Without them this mod does the hurdle/vault/drop itself. Always run own traversal: ignore the other mods (can double-handle an NPC). Passive: never run the own leap; parkour, EVG hop and teleport only as a late fallback.

Stuck humanoids hurdle fences, vault onto ledges and drop down toward their target along a collision-checked arc with the vanilla jump animations. No animation files needed. Switched off automatically while Fluid Motion or NpcTraversalNG owns NPC jumps (Auto mode). Tuning (heights, distances) is in NPCPathingNG.ini under [Leap].
When you use SkyParkour or an EVG traversal marker, followers reaching that spot replay the move. Works with Nether's Follower Framework and any mod that flags followers as teammates.
Turn ON to leave followers completely untouched (also disables replay).
OFF by default so guards and enemies chasing you can climb after you. Turn ON if combat parkour causes oddities in your setup.
Riders (and their horses) are left alone. Recommended ON.
